habitica-batch-tasks/features/batch: Create multiple To-Dos or Dailies at once from line-separated text
habitica-batch-tasks/features/privacy: Credentials stored only in your browser, sent directly to Habitica
habitica-batch-tasks/features/progress: Concurrent creation (3 at a time) with per-task success and failure results
habitica-batch-tasks/features/subtasks: Sub-Tasks mode builds a single task with a checklist of sub-tasks
habitica-batch-tasks/how_to_use/step1: Find your API User ID and API Token on the Habitica Settings / Site Data page.
habitica-batch-tasks/how_to_use/step2: Enter them in the settings card - they are saved in your browser for next time.
habitica-batch-tasks/how_to_use/step3: Switch between Tasks (one per line) and Sub-Tasks (title + checklist), then pick Todo or Daily.
habitica-batch-tasks/how_to_use/step4: Click Create Batch. Successful tasks are cleared; any failures stay for retry.
habitica-batch-tasks/input/placeholder:
One task name per line, e.g.
Read for 30 minutes
Morning run
Practice piano
habitica-batch-tasks/message/error: An error occurred while creating the tasks.
habitica-batch-tasks/message/no_checklis: Please enter at least one sub-task.
habitica-batch-tasks/message/no_credenti: Please fill in your API User ID and API Token.
habitica-batch-tasks/message/no_tasks: Please enter at least one task name.
habitica-batch-tasks/note: Batch create Habitica To-Dos or Dailies, or build a single task with a checklist of sub-tasks.
habitica-batch-tasks/options/task_title_: Title of the task that holds the sub-tasks
